name: zinc finger protein 384
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ZNF384 encodes zinc finger protein 384. Annotated molecular activities include transcription cis-regulatory region binding and sequence-specific double-stranded DNA binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma; Acute leukemia of ambiguous lineage. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
